query: with lesson_checks as (select s.name as serie, l.title, coalesce(length(l.content), 0) as content_length, l.is_active, count(distinct e.id) as exercise_count, count(distinct q.id) as quiz_count, count(distinct eq.id) as exercise_question_count, count(distinct qq.id) as quiz_question_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id = o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id = o.level_id join public.series s on s.id = o.series_id left join public.exercises e on e.lesson_id = l.id left join public.exercise_questions eq on eq.exercise_id = e.id left join public.quizzes q on q.lesson_id = l.id left join public.quiz_questions qq on qq.quiz_id = q.id where sub.name = 'Histoire-Géographie' and lv.name = 'Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2','C','D') and l.title in ('Leçon 4 — L’Union africaine (UA)', 'Leçon 1 — Croyances et valeurs dominantes dans le monde occidental', 'Leçon 2 — Les mutations contemporaines de la civilisation négro-africaine') group by s.name, l.title, l.content, l.is_active), citation_checks as (select sub.name as subject, count(*) as citation_count, count(*) filter (where c.is_active = false and c.is_validated = false) as inactive_unvalidated_count, count(*) filter (where c.source_url is not null and c.source_reference is not null) as sourced_count, count(cs.citation_id) as scope_count, count(ct.citation_id) as theme_count from public.citations c join public.subjects sub on sub.id = c.subject_id left join public.citation_scopes cs on cs.citation_id = c.id left join public.citation_themes ct on ct.citation_id = c.id where sub.name in ('Français','Philosophie','Histoire-Géographie','Physique-Chimie') and c.created_at >= '2026-08-20T13:29:00Z' group by sub.name) select 'lesson' as check_type, serie as dimension, title as label, content_length::text as metric_one, is_active::text as metric_two, exercise_count::text as metric_three, quiz_count::text as metric_four, exercise_question_count::text as metric_five, quiz_question_count::text as metric_six from lesson_checks union all select 'citation' as check_type, subject as dimension, 'Citations authentiques du lot' as label, citation_count::text, inactive_unvalidated_count::text, sourced_count::text, scope_count::text, theme_count::text, null::text from citation_checks order by check_type, dimension, label limit 30;
